Posterior summary of scalar hyperparameters

Source: R/hyperparameters.R
compute_posterior_scalars.Rd

Returns a tidy data frame with one row per scalar parameter and columns mean, median, sd, lower, upper.

Usage

compute_posterior_scalars(scalar_draws, prob = 0.95)

Arguments

scalar_draws

Named list of draw vectors. For a bayesqm_fit, pass fit$hyperparams directly.

prob

Coverage probability for the credible interval.

Value

A data frame.
